evidence_accounting_correction.rule: an observation timestamped at or after the exchange's recorded settlement_ts of its contract cannot be prospective pregame evidence (evidence-accounting correction, not a frozen-rule change)
evidence_accounting_correction.history: the earlier INCLUDED version of every corrected observation remains in the evidence file; the newer EXCLUDED version (same observation_id) is authoritative for scoring

frozen_definition.inclusion_rule: As EC-2026-001 but for families GAME_SPREAD and TOTAL_GAMES, requiring a quoted line and a completed match (no retirement).
frozen_definition.required_accuracy_condition: mean absolute error on game differential below the fundamental lane by >= 0.05 games with a paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero
